items.briefing:
Australian organisations should be aware that home batteries and other residential energy devices are emerging as a cybersecurity compliance concern, with connected hardware potentially creating vulnerabilities in broader networks. Separately, AI tools are increasingly challenging traditional security approaches, prompting platforms like GitLab and OpenAI to introduce stronger controls around AI agent activity — a relevant consideration for RTOs adopting AI-assisted tools for administration or training delivery.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation allows staff to connect personal smart devices or home energy systems to work networks remotely, check with your IT team about whether those devices meet your security policy requirements.
